items.title: How Zillow runs 100 million daily notifications on AWS Step Functions
items.summary: Zillow sends more than 100 million personalized notifications a day, each as a short-lived AWS Step Functions Express workflow. See how the Comms Experience team replaced more than 10 campaign generators with one configuration-driven orchestration platform and a library of reusable content modules.
items.creator: Nishita Kheur
